item.tib: theg pa chen po dmar khrid dug lnga rang grol las sngon 'gro mi ldog thar pa'i lam 'dren
item.coloph: ces theg pa chen po dmar khrid dug lnga rang grol zhes pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa 'di ni/ rgyal ba gong ma'i zhal rgyun dang / brgyud (rgyud) gzhan la mi 'dug bsam pa ma lags/ rang 'dra'i blo dman thos chung rnams dang / yang khyed (khyad)grub mtha'i mi gcig pa'i bcos ma rnams kyis/ bon la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mi 'dug theg dman pa yin zer zhing smad 'dug pas/ bcos ma rnams la go brda' sprad pa'i phyir du bon spyod yan lag bdun pa'i theg chen sngon 'gro 'di/ khyung dkar ru ba'i sprang 'khyams po bstan 'dzin rin chen du 'bod pa'i gang dran yin pa bkra shis su gyur cig/
